decision_review.reason: Each original candidate has a literal 0–10 historical range, missing competition/bid fields and no permitted ceiling-constrained forecast. None presently demonstrates attainable profitable paid traffic at the required ceiling.
decision_review.adversarial_challenge: Prior country order totals and promising product intent are insufficient to fund these particular phrases: they are not current keyword CPC, localized buyer-path, attribution or cost evidence. Conversely, these nine ranges are not grounds to reject entire countries or infer zero demand.

currency_review.support: Recorded official account-currency immutability search excerpt; full-page fetch returned HTTP429 and stopped.
currency_review.limitation: The inference depends on the correctness of the accepted historical USD context. This reviewer did not independently retrieve the documentation or native currency metadata; no monetary evidence was converted or fabricated.

save_and_forecast_review.limit: These are scoped UI-action and table readbacks, not an independent backend replay or a claim that all Google interfaces lack another forecast path.

Dash/null fields retain unknown cause. Search-result excerpts, successful document reads and stopped HTTP429 fetches remain distinct; no blocked URL was retried by this reviewer.
Historical CSV product, route, order and cost hypotheses remain dated. The September 11 Planner source was used only for same-account currency context, not its old seeds or market metrics.
